# QR

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Factor a positive diagonal matrix without pivoting. For this diagonal input the native QR factors are Q = I and R = A.

## What this example demonstrates

Factor a positive diagonal matrix without pivoting. For this diagonal input the native QR factors are Q = I and R = A.
